evidence: Access the Ohakune Old Coach Road from Ohakune or Horopito. It's a one way walk or ride so you'll need to return the same way or arrange transport back.
From the station follow the footpath to the Mangawhero River Bridge and cross over onto Old Station Road.
From here the trail crosses the stream and follows the Old Coach Road through to Horopito.

doubts: Start: the text starts the walk at the Ohakune railway station, which has no feature of its own; T3 is the Ohakune town place it lies in, so the ref is a judgement. End: Horopito is the place T2, which the text names as the end. Shape: the page says it is a one way walk and that you return the same way or arrange transport, so W1 is one_way; W2 is the page's 'return to Ohakune' option from the viaduct, which the same statement supports as an out and back, but the page does not give it its own heading, time or distance. Marshalls Road is walked from the station to the carpark (about 1.5 km and a turn), recorded as a road; the carpark F4 is taken from the feature where Ohakune Coach Road meets Marshalls Road. The Heritage section says the Taonui Viaduct will not be restored for visitor use and that access to view it is being restored as a side track, which conflicts with the description that the trail goes down to it; it is kept in via on the main description. The text says the trail crosses Haeremaere Stream but does not say whether there is a bridge, so no ford is recorded. The Matapuna Road parking area is not matched to a feature and does not say which end of the walk it joins. Time and distance for W1 are DOC's header values; W2 has none on the page.
